server_environment: PostgreSQL runs in a local Docker container on the same client host, using postgres:18-alpine image digest b6972e1115a4ff8eba5d7f7d19184926d1e16d7d1136ae1e1a7ebf286da0f015; max_connections=200. SQLite runs on the host filesystem. No other test suites were running during this measurement. CPU model was unavailable under host permissions; architecture and logical CPU count are recorded.
method: Barrier-synchronized bursts using asyncio and bounded thread pools; connection/approval costs included; no retries, models or external effects.
limitations: Small local bursts, not sustained production load. Global audit lock serializes writes. Percentiles include errors; samples and errors retained. No latency confidence interval claimed.
